top_signals.title: ArcelorMittal Unable to Restart Ukraine Operations After Strikes
top_signals.summary: ArcelorMittal SA has advised the Ukrainian government that it is unable to safely restart its steel operations in the country after a series of missile strikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Set for First Weekly Gain in Four as Oil Eases
top_signals.summary: European shares advanced as bond yields stabilized and oil pulled back on hopes that the Strait of Hormuz could soon reopen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Kobayashi in $3.2 Billion Buyout Talks After Red-Yeast Case
top_signals.summary: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., the Japanese health products company that was at the center of a supplement contamination scandal involving suspected deaths, is said to be considering a potential buyout offer of more than ¥500 billion ($3.2 billion) by private equity investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Samourai Wallet co-founder faces new transfer after 30-day ordeal
top_signals.summary: Keonne Rodriguez says he and 70 others face another move after their treatment program was deactivated. His previous transfer took 30 days.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
